annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院 (State Council of the People's Republic of China)
key_provisions_or_claims: Establishes national and local command bodies with local government head responsibility for forest and grassland fire prevention and suppression
Requires fire-prevention zones and periods, controls on open fire use, and a four-level color-coded fire risk warning system
Sets tiered reporting obligations and four-level fire classification by area burned and casualties
Imposes fines and administrative sanctions for violations
Encourages technology, informatization and intelligent upgrading of fire prevention equipment; replaces the 2008 Forest Fire Prevention and Grassland Fire Prevention regulations from 1 Jan 2026
annotation.summary_en: State Council Order No. 822 promulgating the Forest and Grassland Fire Prevention and Suppression Regulations, effective 1 January 2026. It sets institutional responsibilities, prevention, firefighting, post-fire handling and legal liability for forest and grassland fires. It is not about AI or robotics beyond a general call for informatization and technological upgrading.
annotation.title_en: Regulations on Forest and Grassland Fire Prevention and Suppression
annotation.venue: 中华人民共和国国务院令第822号
